    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">.NET上位机踩坑：大小端和字节序</span>
    

</a>

	</div>
	<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1 data-layout-id="0"><span>前言</span></h1>
<p><span>大家好，我是 wacky。</span></p>
<p><span>今天聊个具体的坑——字节序和大小端。这坑我刚入行那会儿踩过，盯着采集上来的温度显示 1.347e-38，一度怀疑人生。</span></p>
<p><span>很多上位机新手有个错觉：从 PLC 把寄存器读上来，转换一下不就是个数了吗？实际上真没那么简单。一个 32 位浮点数跨两个寄存器，中间隔着"大小端"和"字节序"两道关，任何一道没对齐，你看到的就是天书。</span></p>
<h1 data-layout-id="4"><span>一、大小端到底是什么</span></h1>
<p><span>大小端（endianness）说的是：一个多字节的数，它的各个字节在内存里的存储顺序。</span></p>
<p><span>大端（big-endian）：也叫大端模式或者网络字节序，在大端模式中，数据的高位字节，存储在低位地址内，而低位字节，存储在高位地址内。</span></p>
<p><span>举个例子，现在有一个数字0x12345678，按照大端存储，那么就是高位字节0x12存储在低位地址，低位字节0x78存储在高位地址。</span></p>
<p><span>如图所示：</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/443744/202608/443744-20260830105555606-2120157615.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span>小端（little-endian）：也叫小端模式或者主机序。小端模式和大端模式刚好相反，数据的高位字节在高位地址内，而低位字节，存储在低位地址内。</span></p>
<p><span>继续以0x12345678为例，按照小端存储，就是低位字节0x78存储在低位地址，高位字节0x12存储在高位地址。</span></p>
<p><span>如同所示：</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/443744/202608/443744-20260830105621716-476469049.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span>一句话总结：大端像人写字（高位先写），小端像 x86 存数（低位先放）。</span></p>
<p><span>工控程序里真正的麻烦在于：PLC 用大端、上位机用小端是常态。你从 Modbus 把字节读上来，直接丢给 BitConverter.ToSingle，出来的往往不是原来的数——因为字节顺序没对齐，你必须按照PLC的大小端去解析。</span></p>
<h1 data-layout-id="14"><span>二、工控用 ABCD / BADC / CDAB / DCBA 四种记号</span></h1>
<span>光说"大小端"还不够细。一个 32 位浮点数 = 4 字节 = 2 个 Modbus 寄存器，所以实际应用中还存在大端反转、小端反转的情况。因此其实有四种字节顺序，而工控领域习惯用四个字母描述这 4 个字节的顺序，记法固定——A 是最高位字节，D 是最低位字节：</span>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.ComponentModel;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> BigAndLittleDian
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">internal</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">enum</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DataFormat
    {
        [Description(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">按照顺序排序</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
        ABCD </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        [Description(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">按照单字反转</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
        BADC </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        [Description(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">按照双字反转</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
        CDAB </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        [Description(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">按照倒序排序</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
        DCBA </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="cs"><span style="font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px"><br>大小端模式只是一种规定数据存储的字节顺序方式，在与不同的硬件进行通信时，上位机程序需要根据对方的大小端模式进行正确的解析和处理，而且不同类型的硬件大小端模式是在设计时已经确定，一般不会发生改变。</span></pre>
<h1 data-layout-id="18"><span>三、经典翻车现场：浮点数读成 1.347e-38</span></h1>
<p><span>场景：PLC 那边把温度存成 32 位 float，占两个保持寄存器。比如地址 40001 是高字、40002 是低字（也可能反过来，这个和厂商有关）。</span></p>
<p><span>你的.NET 程序从 Modbus 读到两个 ushort，然后 BitConverter.ToSingle 一转，期望得到 25.5。结果屏幕上蹦出来 1.347e-38，或者一个几万的数。</span></p>
<p><span>为什么？因为 BitConverter 默认按小端（DCBA）解析。PLC 那边如果是大端（ABCD）或者字序有反转（CDAB），你直接 ToSingle，等于把字节全打乱重新拼，最后出来的结果当然不是原值。</span></p>
<p><span>当年我对着这个玩意儿纠结了半天，最后才发现是设备的字节序是 CDAB，而我按 ABCD 读了。差这一个字母，结果就天差地别。</span></p>
<h1 data-layout-id="23"><span>四、C# 示例：四种顺序怎么转</span></h1>
<p><span>核心思路：不管设备用哪种顺序存，先把读到的 4 个字节重排成 .NET 需要的 DCBA（小端），再 ToSingle。下面我们可以定义一个函数，把四种情况一网打尽：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> BigAndLittleDian
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">internal</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ReadAndWrite
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 从 2 个寄存器还原浮点数</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span> ReadFloat(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ushort</span> reg0, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ushort</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> reg1, DataFormat order)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] raw = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">];
            BitConverter.GetBytes(reg0).CopyTo(raw, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            BitConverter.GetBytes(reg1).CopyTo(raw, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] dcb = order <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">switch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                DataFormat.ABCD </span>=&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { raw[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>], raw[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>], raw[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>], raw[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>] },  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 大端</span>
                DataFormat.DCBA =&gt; raw,                                      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 小端</span>
                DataFormat.BADC =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { raw[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>], raw[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>], raw[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>], raw[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>] }, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 单字反转</span>
                DataFormat.CDAB =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { raw[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>], raw[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>], raw[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>], raw[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>] }, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 双字反转</span>
                _ =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> raw
            };

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> BitConverter.ToSingle(dcb, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

        }


        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 反过来：把浮点数按指定顺序写进 2 个寄存器</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ushort</span>[] WriteFloat(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> value, DataFormat order)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] dcb =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> BitConverter.GetBytes(value);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] raw = order <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">switch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                DataFormat.ABCD </span>=&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { dcb[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>], dcb[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>], dcb[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>], dcb[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">] },
                DataFormat.DCBA </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dcb,
                DataFormat.BADC </span>=&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { dcb[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>], dcb[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>], dcb[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>], dcb[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">] },
                DataFormat.CDAB </span>=&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { dcb[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>], dcb[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>], dcb[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>], dcb[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">] },
                _ </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dcb
            };

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { BitConverter.ToUInt16(raw, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>), BitConverter.ToUInt16(raw, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) };
        }
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>要点：不要靠猜，如果没有手册，那么就把四种组合都试一遍。PLC 里写的是123.45，分别用 ABCD / BADC / CDAB / DCBA 读，哪种正确就使用哪种，然后写进配置。</p>
<h1 data-layout-id="27"><span>五、怎么快速判断是不是这个坑</span></h1>
<p><span>几个典型症状：</span><span>整数偶尔对、浮点必错 —— 基本就是字节/字序问题。</span></p>
<p><span>数值数量级完全不对：1e-38、1e+38、或者动辄几万 —— 字节被重排了。</span></p>
<p><span>排查办法很朴素：把原始的 4 个字节（或 2 个寄存器）通过日志打印出来，和 PLC 监控里的值对照，按 ABCD / BADC / CDAB / DCBA 四种组合算一遍，哪种对就能确定该使用哪种。</span></p>
<h1 data-layout-id="32"><span>后记</span></h1>
<p><span>字节序和大小端看似是个很小的知识点，实际上是上位机最经典的坑之一。它本质上是"你和 PLC 对数据格式的约定没对齐"，就类似于我们Web前后端来开发接口，要约定好数据格式。我们把字节序的几种读取都封装好，把接口文档定义清楚，那么这个坑就填平了。</span></p>
<p><span>踩坑系列虽然没有体系可言，但是每个问题深究起来确实也很有意思，也希望能帮助到正在学习或者已经入坑的你们，诸君共勉！</span></p>
<p><span>本文首发于我的公众号【wacky的碎碎念】，欢迎关注追更！</span></p>
